# bookmatch — component architecture

## Components

### `bookmatch.app`
- **Role:** HTTP entry point exposing `/api/health`; verifies schema readiness via `storage.ensure_schema_ready` at startup.
- **Entry point:** `bookmatch/app.py`

### `bookmatch.storage`
- **Role:** Owns the `books.*` schema bootstrap and upgrade path; exposes `ensure_schema_ready` which verifies schema presence and raises if missing.
- **Entry point:** `bookmatch/storage.py`

### `bookmatch.agent`
- **Role:** UNKNOWN (fact not harvested).
- **Entry point:** `bookmatch/agent.py`

## Connections

- `bookmatch.app` calls `storage.ensure_schema_ready` to verify the `books.*` schema exists before serving.
- `bookmatch.storage` reads and writes the `books.*` schema in Postgres.

## Diagram

```mermaid
graph LR
    app[bookmatch.app] -->|ensure_schema_ready| storage[bookmatch.storage]
    storage -->|reads/writes| pg[(Postgres books.*)]
```
